fixedVisibleDifferences: The wide title-bar control in the middle of the Agents Window is gone.
The sidebar leads with the reference's four navigation rows instead of a small New Chat pill and icon-only filter/search controls.
Projects and Repositories sections exist, with a real New Project row and a repository filter whose toggle reveals an input that narrows the visible repository rows.

The sidebar ends where the reference ends: the Getting Started card and the profile/settings row that the brief's sections 5.4 and 5.5 asked for were removed once the real reference screenshot showed neither, on the user's decision to follow Cursor. The Open Folder capability stays reachable from the New Project row, the Projects header + and the Repositories add button.
The detached Customizations footer heading is removed from the DOM, and Customize remains reachable from the new top navigation row.

Utility cards are the reference's own size: 121x96 CSS with a 13px gap, measured off the native reference capture (borders on x 2780/3022 and 3048/3290, y 984/1177 and 1203/1396). The first pass of this slice shipped 75x60 because the brief's 148x120 was read as device pixels of a 2x capture instead of as the 3420-to-2048 resized copy it is; with the real screenshots in hand that is corrected and verified.
The sidebar and utility dividers land on the reference at the reference's own window size: sidebar 267 CSS against 267, utility left 1321 against 1325 (4 CSS from the workbench's right-hand gutter).
The utility pane paints no header, toolbar or divider in the empty Agent Home state.

Sidebar and utility dividers are now reference shares: measured 15.669% / 22.563% against the reference's 15.625% / 22.510%, which converts to 321 and 1586 captured px against the reference's 320 and 1587.
remainingVisibleDifferences: The brief's sections 5.4 and 5.5 (a Getting Started card and a profile/settings row) are deliberately NOT implemented: the reference sidebar has neither, and the user chose the reference over the brief. The test now pins their absence.

The four launch cards and both dividers match the reference, but the whole layout sits 4 CSS px left of it because the workbench reserves a 4px gutter at the right of the window (titlebar 1706 of 1710).

Repositories and Projects render their empty-state rows in the tested profile because no workspace folder was open in the Agents window - the reference capture has three repository rows - and the Agents window cannot be given a folder from the command line (openAgentsWindow only forwards a folder from a protocol link), while `--folder-uri` opened a plain IDE window instead. The rows and the filter's narrowing are wired to real workspace folders but were not exercised with one open.

Below roughly 1330 CSS of window width the reference column shares fall under the base part minimums (sidebar 170px, editor 300px, both in src/vs/workbench/**) and are clamped; at the reference's own 1710 CSS width the sidebar is exact and only the 4px gutter remains.

The title bar is 35 CSS px tall in both windows, so the brief's `titlebarBottomY 47` is the resized-capture reading of the same strip rather than a different one; no titlebar height work is outstanding.
Search opens the sessions list find (sessionsViewPane.find) rather than a full-text search surface; transcript indexing is deferred as the request allows.

The composer row is still Caret's `Workspace` picker where the reference shows `caret v Select branch v This Mac v` plus the Plan/Build chips, `High` and four suggestion rows - that is the next slice, and the reference now gives its exact copy and placement.
The base session list still renders below the new navigation; the reference's empty home has no task rows.
